fields.summary_ko.0: Microsoft (MSFT) recorded Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue of $92.3 billion (19% growth year-over-year) and non-GAAP earnings per share of $4.89 (18% growth), exceeding analyst expectations
fields.summary_ko.1: Azure revenue increased 48% to $33.2 billion, Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 30% to $63.9 billion, and AI-focused 'Agents and Infra' segment revenue grew 25% to $76.8 billion
fields.summary_ko.2: Remaining performance obligations (RPO) expanded 73% year-over-year to $677 billion, suggesting AI is not replacing Microsoft products and indicating strong additional growth momentum
